alternative_explanations: Any apparent gain may be chance coverage by a fixed random symbolic feature pool rather than a reusable evolutionary principle, while exhaustive population evaluation may dominate full cost.
confounds: This one-seed locally visible synthetic cellular family cannot establish general symbolic evolution, cross-family transfer, or an LLM successor.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate if training latent amplitudes overlap the held-out scoring amplitude interval.
Invalidate if an implementable role receives latent coordinates, encoder permutation/signs, targets before prediction or privileged local coefficients.

Invalidate unless all three prospective roles share anonymous inputs, program language, initial population, constants, proposal order, execution, output bounds and accounting, differing only in true-fitness, preregistered shuffled-fitness or frozen-population selection.
Invalidate if dormant zero cells are omitted from dense-control cost or implicitly scanned without charging operations and bytes.
Invalidate if corruption is generated after the clean target is exposed or if repair uses evaluator-private channel semantics.
Invalidate if the program language, population size, mutation/recombination operators, selection rule, generation count, clipping or tie rule changes after any scoring output.
Invalidate if candidate fitness uses scoring worlds, scoring targets, family labels, native mechanism names or evaluator-private coefficients.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, external model/API use, state-budget breach or evaluator-integrity change.

falsification_criteria: Discard if main misses any frozen 0.01 aggregate or per-K D8/D16 NRMSE margin, stability, worst-scale, damaged-input, K-slope, source-identity, accounting or Pareto gate; invalidate on target/latent/scoring-world access, changed language/population/coefficients/shuffle/update, missing control, preflight or integrity failure.

outcome_policy.negative: A valid quality, causal-ablation, stability, scaling, accounting or Pareto failure falsifies this exact 256-program language, proposal, selection, shuffle and update rule without tuning or replication.
outcome_policy.null: If selection improves quality but ridge/kernel or a source-identical role matches capability at lower full cost, preserve the diagnostic selection effect and falsify the registered capability-cost conjunction.
outcome_policy.positive: Retain HYP-0048 only as one-seed scout evidence and authorize unchanged three-seed adversarial replication; do not promote or tune.

predicted_outcome: Using exactly 256 programs per output with program 0 persistence, fixed 1/2/3-term ranges 1-63/64-159/160-255, coefficient grid -1,-0.5,-0.25,0.25,0.5,1, raw/tanh/product primitives, deterministic proposal and shuffle seeds, true fitness selection should lower aggregate NRMSE by at least 0.01 versus shuffled and frozen roles and the strongest complete ridge/kernel control, preserve the margin at every K for D8/D16, remain stable and K-independent, and be implementably Pareto non-dominated after all proposal evaluations and workloads are charged.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; only complete passage of every quality, ablation, stability, scaling, full-cost and Pareto gate may authorize an unchanged three-seed adversarial replication.
research_question: Can true observation-driven fitness selection over an identical frozen population of 256 short anonymous local programs improve unseen-amplitude cellular rollout quality per full cost beyond shuffled fitness, no selection, ridge and kernel controls?
title: Population-selected anonymous local rule scout
